introduction.zh: 不考剧情，也不按图片造型猜MBTI。18道普通小事题，比较参与速度、共同说明、新玩法、愿望、小舒适与经验分享；六位角色各有完整说明，最高并列全部保留。
introduction.en: Explore your character match through everyday moments, from joining a gathering to enjoying a small comfort. This edition includes six characters: Chiikawa, Hachiware, Usagi, Momonga, Kurimanju and Rakko. Your result includes examples and character comparisons, with a full guide for every character tied for your highest count.

instructions.zh: 这份18题原创非官方同人问卷，以吉伊卡哇、小八、兔兔、小桃、栗子馒头和海獭六位角色，帮助比较当前普通小事里的参与、表达、玩法、愿望、舒适与经验分享。每题选四个做法中较接近自己的一个，均以自愿、可改和可停止为前提；不要求模仿讨伐、饮酒、索取或剧情伤害。每选加1，六位各出现12次，所有最高并列完整显示。角色名不等于真实动物、性别、年龄、人格或心理状况，结果不判断能力、道德、关系或职业，不换算MBTI。无需看全作品，基础背景只用于理解同人读法。
instructions.en: For each of the 18 original questions, choose the one of four responses that feels closest to what you would do now. There are no right answers, and you don't need to know every episode. Each choice adds one to a character's count. After all 18 questions, you'll see your counts and a full guide for every character with the highest count. This unofficial fan quiz is for fun; it doesn't determine a fixed personality or an MBTI type.

summary.en: Explore participation at your pace through a small display, wording and five character comparisons. Appearance, shyness, tears and mental states are not assigned to you.

scoreReading.zh: 18题全部各选一项，对应的本版角色方向加1，总数固定18。每题提供六位中的四位，全卷每位12次、每位置3次；未提供的两位不记拒绝。所有最高计数完整保留，全选第一项会六位各3次、六份完整显示。名单顺序不设主次，不自动指定第二角色；次数不是相似度百分比、真实人格比例或成为角色的概率。差一次只是一项选择，不证明显著差异、某种品质消失或固定类型。可自行比较近分说明，但不补造并列、隐藏性格或混合身份。当前情境、时间和理解可能改变选择，没有人群常模、稀有度、科学分界或心理测量验证。
scoreReading.en: Choose one option for all 18 items; each adds one to its editorial character direction and counts sum to 18. Four of six characters are offered per item. Each appears 12 times and three times in each position; absent options are not rejections. Every highest count keeps its full guide. Choosing the first option throughout gives three each and all six guides. List order establishes no priority or automatic second character. Counts are neither similarity percentages, actual personality proportions nor probabilities of being a character. One extra choice proves neither significance, missing qualities nor a fixed type. Read close guides without inventing ties, hidden traits or mixed identities. Context, time and understanding can change choices; there are no population norms, rarity estimates, scientific cutoffs or psychometric validation.

description.en: Read Chiikawa through joining a small display at your pace. Full examples and comparisons without assigning shyness, tears, appearance or mental states.

title.en: Character context and this edition’s reading

paragraphs.zh: 官方人物介绍中的吉伊卡哇有温柔、谨慎的一面，作品也包含困难的日常。本站只借“慢一点也可以参与”作同人读法，不把整个人物定成胆小，也不把温柔当作必须忍让。人物外形与表达方式属于作品设定，不决定答题者的物种、性别、年龄或需要别人怎样照顾。
paragraphs.en: Official character context includes a gentle, cautious side to Chiikawa, within a world that can be difficult. This edition selects joining at a gentler pace as a fan reading without reducing the whole character to timidity or making gentleness require yielding. Fictional appearance and expression establish no respondent’s species, gender, age or entitlement to decide how others should care for them.

title.zh: 计数对应哪些当前选择
title.en: Which current choices the count describes

paragraphs.zh: 若次数最高，本次较常选择先看一会儿、从舒服的位置加入，或等自己准备好再表达。可以问：什么部分想参加，怎样的速度更符合意愿，现在是否想说话？原始次数不判断勇气、脆弱、内向、抗压或焦虑；少选也可能只是对眼前活动很熟悉，不说明粗心、冷漠或不懂照顾自己。
paragraphs.en: A highest count means you more often chose to observe, join from a comfortable position or speak when ready. Which part interests you, what pace suits your wishes and do you want to speak now? Raw counts establish no courage, fragility, introversion, stress tolerance or anxiety. Fewer choices may reflect familiarity rather than carelessness, coldness or poor attention to your actual needs.

title.en: A concrete ordinary example

paragraphs.zh: 例如，你想看看一个可自由离开的小展示，可以先在边缘看一件物品，再决定要不要和别人聊。看完一件就离开也算一次自己选择的参与，而不是失败或需要补考的社交。若有明确入场时间、拥挤或安全条件，需要另外核实；例子不要求强行突破，也不保证慢看会带来某种改变。
paragraphs.en: At a small display with free entry and exit, look at one object from the edge before deciding whether to talk. Leaving after that can be your chosen participation rather than a social failure to correct. Check actual timing, crowding and safety separately. The example requires no forced breakthrough and promises no particular personal change from taking a slower look at an ordinary activity.

title.en: A possible way to express the preference

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“我想先慢慢看一会儿，愿意时再加入，你不用一直等我。”如果是共同安排，再确认别人能否按自己的方式继续。给自己留速度，也给对方留不陪同的空间；这不是要求所有人迁就，更不意味着你必须始终柔软、安静或让别人决定。愿意直接参与或说不，也都可以。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “I’d like to look slowly first and join when I want; you don’t need to wait for me.” In a shared arrangement, confirm that others can continue their own way. Room for your pace also leaves them free not to accompany you. It requires neither everyone’s accommodation nor perpetual softness, silence or letting others decide; direct participation and refusal remain possible.

title.en: Comparisons with the other five character readings

paragraphs.zh: 吉伊卡哇读法偏参与速度，小八偏把意思说清，兔兔偏出其不意的玩法；慢看也可以边说边玩。小桃偏让愿望可见，栗子馒头偏享受具体舒适，海獭偏分享试过的一点经验。这里没有主角优先、勇敢等级或谁更值得喜欢，最高并列也不规定你得按名单顺序表现。
paragraphs.en: This Chiikawa angle concerns participation pace, Hachiware putting meaning into words and Usagi unexpected play; a slow look can include both conversation and play. Momonga concerns visible wishes, Kurimanju small comforts and Rakko specific experience. There is no protagonist priority, bravery rank or greater worthiness of affection, and a highest tie imposes no order in which you must perform the characters’ approaches.

title.zh: 反例与不能推断的现实情况
title.en: Counterexamples and actual circumstances not inferred

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，先观察可能因为光线、语言、疲劳或不熟悉规则，而不是一种稳定偏好；快参与同样可以很细心。本版不从选择判断焦虑、社交困难、依恋、神经类型、健康或成长经历，也不把哭泣当成评分题。真实不适需要具体理解，不由一个可爱角色代替说明或决定你必须怎样面对。
paragraphs.en: Observing first may follow lighting, language, tiredness or unfamiliar rules rather than a lasting preference, while quick participation can be attentive too. Choices infer no anxiety, social difficulty, attachment, neurotype, health or developmental history, and crying is not a scoring criterion. Actual discomfort deserves specific understanding rather than a cute character standing in for an explanation or deciding how it must be handled.

title.en: An optional observation

paragraphs.zh: 可选观察：为一件本来就想看的低风险小事，想一个可以少量参与、也能离开的方式，不必真的去做。看看这种安排是否符合当前意愿，不用按待了多久、讲了几句给勇气打分。也可以直接略过；测试不要求你证明“虽然害怕仍然坚持”，更不把停止看成不够像吉伊卡哇。
paragraphs.en: For an optional observation, imagine a small way to join and leave something low-stakes you already want to see; actual attendance is unnecessary. Notice whether it suits your wishes without grading bravery by time spent or words spoken. Skip it if preferred. This edition selects making wishes visible as a limited reading while retaining the distinction between a request and overstepping; demands and manipulation are not presented as strengths. Fictional appearance, identity and behaviour are not assigned to you, and receiving the name establishes neither selfishness nor deserving dislike from actual people in your life.

title.zh: 计数对应哪些当前选择
title.en: Which current choices the count describes

paragraphs.zh: 若次数最高，本次较常选择直接说出想看、想留或希望别人注意的具体一处。可以问：自己到底想要什么，是提出请求还是已经默认别人答应，能不能接受不同回应？计数不检验表达效果、受欢迎程度或动机，也不证明你需要关注。少选可能是当时没有偏好、不方便说或不愿分享，并不等于更无私。
paragraphs.en: A highest count means you more often chose to state a particular wish or detail you hope someone notices. What do you want, is it a request rather than assumed agreement, and can different responses stand? Counts observe neither effectiveness, popularity nor motives and establish no attention need. Fewer choices may reflect no preference, limited opportunity or privacy rather than greater selflessness in an actual situation.

title.en: A concrete ordinary example

paragraphs.zh: 例如，一起选普通小纪念物时，你可以说“我喜欢这个蓝色的，想留这一份；如果已经有人选了，我们再商量”。不需要先演成不在意，也不能擅自拿走别人已选的东西。愿望被说出来，只意味着对方有机会听见，并不保证会实现；是否有余量、归属和如何分配，仍要按实际条件谈清。
paragraphs.en: Choosing ordinary keepsakes together, say which blue one you would like and suggest discussion if it is already chosen. You need neither perform indifference nor take something another person selected. An expressed wish gives others a chance to hear it without guaranteeing fulfilment. Availability, ownership and distribution still need to be discussed in their actual circumstances rather than settled by a character-like manner of asking.

title.en: A possible way to express the preference

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“这是我想要的，不过你可以说不；我不想让你靠猜。”表达清楚不等于一定礼貌或无害，若对方拒绝、说不舒服或要求停，需要听见并停止。不能借可爱、玩笑或角色名绕过同意，也不需要为了结果维持讨喜形象；别人不承担安慰、赞美或满足每个愿望的责任。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “This is what I’d like, and you can say no; I don’t want you to have to guess.” Clear expression is not automatically harmless. Hear refusal or discomfort and stop when asked. Cuteness, humour and a character name cannot bypass agreement, and a result requires no appealing performance or obligation on others to reassure, praise or fulfil every expressed wish.

title.en: Comparisons with the other five character readings

paragraphs.zh: 小桃这一读法偏愿望可见，兔兔偏玩法新奇；说出想法可以很普通，不一定寻求惊喜或表演。小八偏共同说明，吉伊卡哇偏参与速度，栗子馒头偏享受细节，海獭偏经验分享。六者都需要尊重实际意愿，没有“最自我”或“最善良”的排序，也不把这一名字换成自恋、依恋或其他人格分数。
paragraphs.en: This Momonga angle concerns visible wishes, while Usagi concerns novelty; stating a preference can be ordinary without surprise or performance. Hachiware concerns wording, Chiikawa pace, Kurimanju comforts and Rakko experience. All require respect for actual wishes. There is no ranking of selfishness or kindness, and the name converts into neither narcissism, attachment nor another personality score for an actual respondent or someone they know.

title.en: Counterexamples and actual circumstances not inferred

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，一次明确表达可能因为物品要提前预留，不是稳定偏好；没有开口也可能只是没有兴趣。计数不识别操控、恶意、孤独、缺爱、危险性或任何心理原因。不能拿角色当骂人标签，也不能用“只是像小桃”免除真实越界的责任；现实行为需要按具体事实、同意和影响理解。
paragraphs.en: An explicit request may follow a reservation requirement rather than a stable preference, while silence may simply mean no interest. Counts identify neither manipulation, malice, loneliness, unmet affection, danger nor psychological causes. Do not use a character as an insult or as an exemption for actual overstepping. Understand real behaviour through specific facts, agreement and impact rather than a voluntary quiz name alone.

paragraphs.en: For an optional observation, write one small wish you already want to express and one sentence leaving room for refusal. Keep it unsent if preferred. Notice whether both reflect your meaning without checking for praise, fulfilment or improved relationship skill. Skip it or retain privacy; the quiz requires neither becoming better at obtaining things nor performing closer resemblance to a fictional character in actual interactions.

description.en: Read Kurimanju through small comforts, an ordinary photo and quiet sharing. Full comparisons without drinking, health, maturity or emotional-regulation claims.

title.en: Character context and this edition’s reading

paragraphs.zh: 栗子馒头（Kurimanju）是作品中的角色，基础介绍包含与朋友分享食物等日常。本站只借“慢慢享受眼前小舒适”的同人角度，不要求模仿人物饮酒，也不把作品里的饮酒许可当现实规则。可以用光线、颜色、触感或一个安静角落理解这份读法，食物与饮料都不是作答或观察的必需品。
paragraphs.en: Kurimanju’s basic fictional context includes sharing food with friends. This edition borrows savouring a small comfort without inviting imitation of drinking or treating fictional drinking permission as an actual rule. Light, colour, texture or a quiet corner can explain the reading; neither food nor drink is required for the questionnaire or an optional observation of what interests you in an ordinary moment.

title.zh: 计数对应哪些当前选择
title.en: Which current choices the count describes

paragraphs.zh: 若次数最高，本次较常选择慢看细节、留意感受，或不急着给眼前东西派一个用途。可以问：喜欢的是哪种具体感觉，现在想独自待着还是一起分享？次数不观察享受程度、放松效果或生活方式，也不认证成熟、稳定、幸福或会照顾别人。少选可能因为当时忙、没兴趣或条件不合，并不等于不会享受生活。
paragraphs.en: A highest count means you more often chose details, sensations or leaving something without an immediate use. Which feeling appeals, and would you prefer solitude or willing company? Counts observe neither enjoyment, relaxation outcomes nor lifestyle and certify no maturity, stability, happiness or care skill. Fewer choices may follow being busy, uninterested or in unsuitable conditions rather than being unable to enjoy an actual ordinary life.

title.en: A concrete ordinary example

paragraphs.zh: 例如，一张普通风景照让你注意到窗边一小片暖色，可以停下看一会儿，不一定分析拍摄方法或立刻分享。也可以移开视线、换一张或不再看；它没有规定要感觉平静。若同伴想一起看，可以各说喜欢的细节，也允许彼此不同，不把自己的舒适当作别人应该同样舒服的标准。
paragraphs.en: An ordinary landscape photo draws your attention to a small warm colour by a window. Look for a while without analysing technique or sharing immediately. Look away or stop as preferred; no particular calm feeling is required. With willing company, each may name a different detail, without treating your comfort as the standard for what another person should find comfortable in that moment.

title.en: A possible way to express the preference

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“我想慢慢看这一小处，不急着做别的；你可以按自己想的方式继续。”舒适不自动取消已答应的事，若时间或责任有变化，再谈具体安排。也不需要一直安静、懂吃或显得老练来符合栗子馒头的名字；表达不舒服或不想享受同一件东西，也都可以。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “I’d like to spend a little time with this detail without moving on yet; you can continue your own way.” Comfort does not automatically cancel agreed duties; discuss concrete arrangements if timing changes. The character requires neither constant quiet, food expertise nor a seasoned appearance. Expressing discomfort or not wanting the same experience remains possible regardless of the result or someone else’s expectations.

title.en: Comparisons with the other five character readings

paragraphs.zh: 栗子馒头这一读法偏具体舒适，吉伊卡哇偏参与速度：慢看可以是享受，也可以是先弄清环境。小八偏共同说明，兔兔偏新玩法，小桃偏愿望表达，海獭偏经验。安静享受不等于更成熟或更内向，热闹活动也可以很舒服；六种计数不形成恢复能力、情绪调节或生活质量等级。
paragraphs.en: This Kurimanju angle concerns specific comforts, while Chiikawa concerns participation pace; a slower look can be enjoyment or orientation. Hachiware concerns wording, Usagi play, Momonga wishes and Rakko experience. Quiet enjoyment is neither greater maturity nor introversion, and a lively activity can be comfortable. The six counts create no rank of recovery ability, emotional regulation or actual quality of life outside the offered situations.

title.zh: 反例与不能推断的现实情况
title.en: Counterexamples and actual circumstances not inferred

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，停下来可能因为等待、疲劳、身体条件或暂时没有别的事，不一定是偏好。问卷不评估饮食、饮酒、依赖、健康、情绪或年龄，也不提供放松治疗。若现实中有不适，角色名不能解释原因或替代适当处理；本版的普通例子不要求吃喝、购买东西或模仿作品里的习惯。
paragraphs.en: Pausing may follow waiting, tiredness, bodily circumstances or no immediate task rather than preference. The quiz evaluates no eating, drinking, dependence, health, mood or age and supplies no relaxation treatment. A character name explains no actual discomfort or appropriate response to it. Ordinary examples require neither consumption, purchases nor imitation of habits appearing in the fictional series or another person’s interpretation of it.

title.en: An optional observation

paragraphs.zh: 可选观察：在一件原本就愿意看的小东西里，找一个自己喜欢的颜色或细节，不必停很久、拍照或分享。留意这种注意是否符合当前兴趣，不检查自己有没有变平静、被治愈或获得更好的生活方式。可以直接略过；舒适不是必须完成的任务，也不需要在真实忙碌中强行挤出一种角色式仪式。
paragraphs.en: For an optional observation, notice a colour or detail in something small you already want to see. No prolonged pause, photograph or sharing is required. Notice your interest without checking whether you became calm, healed or acquired a better lifestyle. paragraphs.en: A highest count means you more often chose to ask whether help is wanted before mentioning a tried approach and its limits. Is it first-hand, do conditions differ and does the person want it? Counts observe neither correctness, teaching outcomes nor expertise and establish no greater reliability. Fewer choices may mean no relevant experience this time rather than selfishness, inability or indifference to someone else’s situation.

title.en: A concrete ordinary example

paragraphs.zh: 例如，朋友问一张普通纸怎样固定，你说自己曾用折边暂时立起来，但只试过小张、没有承重用途。对方可以采用、改动或不用；如果不是你熟悉的材料，就明确说不知道。经验分享的价值在具体范围，而不是把自己做过一次说成万能方法，更不能将普通小例子扩成危险或专业操作指导。
paragraphs.en: A friend asks how to position ordinary paper. Explain that folding an edge once helped a small sheet stand temporarily, with no load-bearing use tested. They may adapt it or decline. Say when a material is unfamiliar. The point is a specific scope rather than making one attempt a universal method, or expanding an ordinary little example into hazardous or professional instructions beyond what you actually know.

title.en: A possible way to express the preference

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“我试过这一小种情况，你想听听吗？条件不同可能不适用，决定还是由你来做。”对方拒绝就停止，不用凭经验替他决定，也不把没采用当不尊重。自己可以没有答案、请别人说明或不承担这次指导；结果像海獭，不意味着现实中必须成为大家的榜样、保护者或全天候解答者。

It may not apply under different conditions, and the decision remains yours.” Stop at refusal without equating rejection with disrespect. You may lack an answer or decline the role. paragraphs.en: This Rakko angle concerns tried experience, while Hachiware concerns shared wording; clear explanation does not imply experience, and experience does not guarantee applicability. Chiikawa concerns pace, Usagi play, Momonga wishes and Kurimanju comforts. Experience sharing may be quiet or playful, without a higher character level or conversion into leadership, career interest, expertise or a mentor personality describing the whole of an actual respondent’s life.

The quiz measures no qualification, combat, bravery, kindness or teaching ability and maps no fictional weapons or strength to actual bodies. For safety, health, law or major decisions, a character result cannot replace relevant facts, credentials and situation-specific judgement about what is appropriate in the actual circumstances.

answer.zh: 这是费马独立创作的非官方同人问卷，以六位吉伊卡哇角色作当前普通选择的有限阅读角度。官方人物页与授权游戏中文页只核人物基础和名字，不验证本站题目、映射、计数或心理解释；本站与原作者、制作方、授权方和游戏运营方无合作或认可关系，作品和角色权利归相应权利人。18题、选项、解释、例子与规则原创，未采用IDR30题、竞品正文或算法、漫画台词、动画字幕、截图、立绘、游戏素材或其他受保护内容。它不是全作品、全角色或完整人格结论，不推断动物分类、性别、年龄、疾病、焦虑、神经类型、天赋、道德、关系或职业，不模仿饮酒、战斗、索取或伤害，不把可爱作为绕过同意的理由，也不换算MBTI、心理自我状态或其他角色测验。
answer.en: This is an independently authored FermatMind unofficial fan quiz using six Chiikawa characters as limited readings of current ordinary choices. Official character and licensed-game Chinese pages check basic context and names without validating these items, mappings, counts or psychology. There is no partnership or endorsement by creators, producers, licensors or game operators; series and character rights belong to their respective owners. All 18 items, options, explanations, examples and rules are original. No IDR 30-item bank, competitor text or algorithm, comic dialogue, subtitles, screenshots, character art, game assets or other protected material is used. This is no full-series, all-character or complete-personality verdict. It infers no species, gender, age, illness, anxiety, neurotype, talent, morality, relationship or career, invites no imitation of drinking, combat, demands or harm, and makes no cuteness an exemption from agreement. Results convert into no MBTI, ego-state or other character-quiz result.

question.zh: 完整结果、重测和分享免费吗？
question.en: Are full results, retaking and sharing free?

answer.zh: 免费，无需注册、邮箱或另一测试。可先读六份公开说明，完成18题后全部最高并列完整显示；重测清除本次选择，分享自选且不含答案或次数。后续测评不是解锁完整结果的条件。
answer.en: They are free without signup, email or another test. Read all six public guides first; every highest tie appears after 18 choices. Retaking clears the attempt. Optional sharing includes no answers or counts, and further assessments are not conditions for unlocking full results.
